module: Exit guard "confirmMultiseatSettingsExit": when leaving the multi-seat settings screen, delegates the confirmation to ui_multiseat_multiseatSettings.confirmExit(route, params, context). Moves between pause.multiseatSettings and pause.multiseatSettings.vehicleSelector stay in the flow and are allowed; if ui_multiseat_multiseatSettings is not loaded, the exit is allowed.
